types.name: MotionOptions

Per-command limits. Zero means use the compiled machine limit. A `planned`
joint move goes around obstacles: the compiler's motion planner finds its
path (COLLISION.md CL7).

fields.name: writeLogicalDelta

types.name: MotionAxisBlueprint
types.doc:
Stable logical-axis mapping authored separately from runtime joint indices.
Multiple joint IDs are supported so dual-motor axes do not need a different
public MotionSystem API later.

fields.name: hasExplicitMapping
fields.doc: Explicit task-to-joint maps override model transmissions; deprecated.

types.name: ChannelDeclaration
types.doc: Deployment declaration for one process-output channel and its safe value.

types.name: ChannelKind
types.doc: Value kind accepted by a declared process channel.

types.name: EventValue
types.doc: Typed process output carried by a path or timed event.

types.name: EventValueTools
types.doc: Shared validation for event values at immutable container boundaries.

types.name: HoldPolicy
types.doc: Output behavior while the trajectory clock is held.

types.name: PathEvent
types.doc: Immutable process event attached to authored path progress.

types.name: TimedEvent
types.doc: Immutable process event lowered onto the trajectory clock.

types.name: AffineJointMap
types.doc:
What a solver declares when its joint positions are an exact affine function of the tool position (a Cartesian,
CoreXY or gantry machine): `joint[j] = offsets[j] + columns[0][j] * x + columns[1][j] * y + columns[2][j] * z`, with
no tolerance of its own. The executed position then differs from the path's only by the lowering tolerance, so a
planner may check the path where it is sampled and may bound a piece of it in closed form from its direction.
Joints the position does not move (an extruder driven by path distance, the motor behind it) have zero columns.

fields.name: offsets
fields.doc: The joints' positions with the tool at the origin.

fields.name: columns
fields.doc: Per tool coordinate (x, y, z), each joint's position per metre.

fields.name: rate
fields.doc: The rate of joint `joint` for a tool velocity.

types.name: IkTolerance
types.doc: Accuracy and deterministic numerical-solver policy for one IK request.

types.name: KinematicsSolver
types.doc: Transport-neutral forward, inverse, differential and path kinematics contract.

fields.name: fork
fields.doc:
This solver for another thread: the same kinematics and settings, sharing nothing that either
changes, so a planner can solve while its caller keeps using the original. A solver holding
no mutable state returns itself.

fields.name: affineMap
fields.doc:
The exact affine map from tool position to joints when this solver is one (see `AffineJointMap`), else null. The
capability a planner reads to skip checks that exactness makes redundant and to bound motion in closed form.

fields.name: solveDifferential
fields.doc:
Joint rates producing `twist` at `q`. A redundant solver has a family of them; given
`redundancyRate` (d/ds of its redundancy values, e.g. `PathSolution.redundancyRates` at the sample)
it returns the one moving its redundancy (a swivel, external axes) at exactly that rate; without
one, the smallest. Solvers with no redundancy ignore it.

fields.name: solvePath
fields.doc:
One configuration per sample of a path (see `PathRequest`): each solver
searches the way that suits it (an analytic arm across its branches, a
redundant group across its redundancy, a plain one point by point).
Null for a sample that cannot be reached; a search that finds no route
may throw its diagnostic instead.

types.name: PathDriveLimits
types.doc:
Planned process speed on each outgoing sample span, and physical drive
acceleration limits. A fixed process feed is a shape constraint; an air
feed is a cap and may be lowered by its physical time law.

types.name: PathRequest
types.doc:
What `KinematicsSolver.solvePath` is asked for: one joint configuration
per sample of a Cartesian path (`poses` at `distances`), starting at
`startQ`, no joint moving more than `maxJump` between neighbouring
samples. A search weighs each joint's motion by `1 / velocity` (its speed
limit) and keeps at most `maxCandidates` configurations per sample.

fields.name: freedoms
fields.doc: One hard orientation policy per sample.

fields.name: followPointByPoint
fields.doc:
Each sample solved from the previous one: `startQ`, then `solvePose`
seeded by the last answer. A sample that does not solve, and every one
after it, is null (the caller reports where the path became unreachable).

types.name: PathSolution
types.doc:
A solved path: one configuration per sample (null where unreachable), and for a redundant solver
how its redundancy changes along it, d(values)/ds per sample in the order of the solver's
redundancy values (a swivel, external axes), exact from the curve the resolver chose rather than
differenced from the solved samples; null when the solver has no redundancy or the route has no
such curve.

types.name: Pose3
types.doc: Immutable position in metres and unit quaternion in xyzw order.

types.name: RedundantPathSolver
types.doc: A solver that chooses its redundancy along a path and reports how that choice changes (see `PathSolution`).

types.name: SixAxisConfiguration
types.doc:
Geometric configuration and physical joint turn counts.
EAIK's normalized geometric bits: shoulder 2, elbow 1, wrist 4.
Labels are derived from compiled geometry, independently of solution order.

fields.name: turns
fields.doc: Null on a geometric-only pin; six values on every labelled IK result.

types.name: Twist6
types.doc: Immutable linear and angular tool velocity in one reference frame.

types.name: QuinticPolynomial
types.doc: Shared normalized quintics and Bernstein controls for path interpolation and geometric bounds.

fields.name: hermite
fields.signature: (start:Array<Float>, end:Array<Float>, first:Array<Float>, last:Array<Float>, second:Array<Float>, before:Array<Float>, h:Float):Array<Array<Float>>

fields.name: slice
fields.doc: Restrict Bernstein controls to an exact subinterval, still parameterized on [0,1].

fields.name: differenceBound
fields.doc: Convexity bounds the Euclidean norm of a vector polynomial by its controls.

types.name: ArcSegment
types.doc: Planar circular arc in the XY plane with a constant Z coordinate.

fields.name: diagnosticCorners
fields.doc: One-based authored corner index for each diagnostic.

fields.name: sourcePrimitiveIndices
fields.doc: Index of the authored primitive owning each output primitive.

types.name: CircularPlane
types.doc: Ordered plane axes followed by the axial direction.

types.name: CircularSegment
types.doc: Circle in a principal plane, optionally rising along its normal axis.

fields.name: secondDerivativeAt
fields.doc: Cartesian second derivative with respect to travelled distance.

fields.name: distanceTo
fields.doc: Shortest 3D distance, including the axial rise of a helix.

types.name: CornerBlender
types.doc: Planar circular fillets bounded by distance to the authored polyline.

fields.name: GEOMETRY_SHARE
fields.doc:
Share of a blend tolerance the corner geometry may use. The rest bounds
the error of timing the path and lowering it to joint motion, which is
checked against the whole tolerance.

fields.name: CORNER_SPEED_SHARE
fields.doc:
Share of the slower move's speed that a rounded corner must be able to keep to be worth rounding. A machine
holds an arc of radius `r` at no more than `sqrt(a r)` (centripetal acceleration `v^2 / r` is bounded by the
acceleration `a` it gives in the plane), so a corner between very short moves, which only a tiny arc can round
within its tolerance, would be taken at next to no speed: stopping there costs about the same and spares the
timing an arc it cannot resolve. See `minimumRadius`.

fields.name: minimumRadius
fields.doc:
The tightest arc, metres, that a machine giving `acceleration` in the plane can take at `CORNER_SPEED_SHARE` of
`speed`: `(share v)^2 / a`. Zero when the machine's acceleration is unknown (no minimum). A corner whose own
tolerance asks for a tighter arc keeps it (`blendPerCorner`).

fields.name: blendPerCorner
fields.doc:
Each entry bounds deviation at the join after its authored primitive. `minRadii`, when given, is each corner's
tightest worthwhile arc (`minimumRadius`); a corner whose arc would come out tighter, and under half of what its
tolerance wanted, is stopped at.

types.name: DistanceDrive
types.doc:
A joint driven by distance along a path rather than by the pose: an extruder's gear turning so much per metre of
bead. Between nominal intervals the rate is not a step but a ramp, so the joint's velocity stays continuous and its
acceleration finite, and the ramps are shaped so that the filament fed over every run equals the nominal feed
exactly:
- a run that begins at rest (after a travel, or at the start of its plan) climbs 0 -> 1.5 rate -> rate over two ramp
lengths (area 2 rate ramp, as the step it replaces);
- a run that ends does the same backwards;
- a change of rate in the middle of a run is a linear ramp centred on the change.
The profile is piecewise linear in the rate, so the joint's position is piecewise quadratic between the stations
and a quintic Hermite fit through the stations is exact. Timing sees the joint's speed and acceleration limits
like any other joint's.

fields.name: joint
fields.doc: The joint index driven.

fields.name: intervals
fields.doc: The nominal intervals, in order, rebased so that the path starts at 0.

fields.name: ramp
fields.doc: The ramp length the profile aims for, metres.

fields.name: slice
fields.doc: The drive restricted to [from, to] of this path and rebased to start at 0, re-shaped so it starts and ends at rest; null if it drives nothing there.

fields.name: stations
fields.doc: The distances at which the rate changes slope: a path must be sampled at them.

fields.name: maximumRate
fields.doc: The rate is piecewise affine, so its absolute maximum occurs at a station, including startup overshoot.

fields.name: offsetAt
fields.doc: The joint's position change from the path's start, at `distance`.

fields.name: rateAt
fields.doc: d(position)/d(distance); `leaving` picks the side at a station (the rate is continuous, so it matters not).

fields.name: curvatureAt
fields.doc: d(rate)/d(distance): the slope of the ramp leaving (`leaving`) or arriving at `distance`.

fields.name: total
fields.doc: The nominal position change over the whole path: what the rate profile integrates to.

types.name: DriveInterval
types.doc: A stretch of a path along which the driven joint turns at a nominal rate per metre of path.

types.name: GeometricPath
types.doc: Immutable ordered geometric path made from reusable primitives.

fields.name: distanceTo
fields.doc:
How far `point` is from the nearest point of the path. A grid of the cells along the primitives bounds the
search to the cells near the point, so a query costs about the same however long the path is.

types.name: HermitePositionBound
types.doc: Endpoint interpolation error plus a continuous remainder supplied by the primitive's exact geometry.

fields.name: circle
fields.doc: Quintic Hermite remainder: max |f^(6)| * span^6/(6!*64).

types.name: LineSegment
types.doc: Straight Cartesian path primitive.

types.name: NativeJointPath
types.doc: Native C2 joint path. Owns the path handle and lowers against a time law.

fields.name: prepareTimingStream
fields.doc: Snapshot into a bounded queue. The caller owns certification/publication.

types.name: OrientationPolicy
types.doc: Permitted tool orientation along a Cartesian path. Axis is in the path frame.

fields.name: Free
fields.doc: Position only; every orientation is acceptable.

types.name: PathPoint
types.doc: Small transport-neutral Cartesian point used by geometric path primitives.

types.name: PathPrimitive
types.doc: Geometric path primitive parameterized by travelled arc length.

fields.name: tangentAt
fields.doc: Unit tangent in increasing path-distance direction.

fields.name: curvatureAt
fields.doc: Signed planar curvature; zero denotes a straight primitive.

types.name: PathPrimitiveKind
types.doc: Stable type dispatch for primitives stored through PathPrimitive.

types.name: PathTimeLaw
types.doc: Native piecewise-quadratic distance law.

fields.name: timesToDistances
fields.doc:
Path distance reached at each time (seconds from the law's epoch): the inverse of `distanceToTime`,
evaluated in closed form. Times outside the law clamp to its first and last distance.

types.name: PathTimeStage
types.doc: One constant-acceleration span of a path-distance time law.

types.name: PoseArc
types.doc: Circular TCP arc through three non-collinear points in three dimensions.

types.name: PoseDerivatives
types.doc:
First and second derivatives of a pose with respect to path distance, in the
base frame: linear in m/m and 1/m, angular in rad/m and rad/m².

types.name: PoseLine
types.doc: Straight TCP move. Rotation-to-length weight is metres per radian.

fields.name: interpolate
fields.signature: (a:PoseWaypoint, b:PoseWaypoint, t:Float, policy:OrientationPolicy, x:Float, y:Float, z:Float):PoseWaypoint

fields.name: angularRates
fields.doc: Spatial angular derivatives of the exact interpolation used below.

types.name: PosePath
types.doc: Ordered path in one explicit frame, measured in metres of path progress.

fields.name: authoredGeometry
fields.doc: Original geometry for paths that replace corners with tolerance blends.

fields.name: geometryDeviationBound
fields.doc: Proven deviation of the rounded geometry itself; null when the author supplies no bound.

fields.name: drive
fields.doc: A joint driven by distance along the path (an extruder), if any.

fields.name: sub
fields.doc: The primitives from `first` up to (not including) `last` as a path of their own, with the geometry and drive that belong to them.

fields.name: indexAt
fields.doc: The first primitive that ends at or after `distance` (the last one past the end), by bisection.

fields.name: indexAfter
fields.doc: The first primitive that ends after `distance` (the last one past the end).

fields.name: startOf
fields.doc: Where primitive `index` starts along the path.

types.name: PosePositionBound
types.doc:
Optional continuous position bound for a Cartesian quintic interpolating part of this primitive.
Controls are three rows of six Bernstein ordinates on [from,to]. Infinity means no proof.

fields.name: derivativesAt
fields.doc: Derivatives of the pose with respect to distance along this primitive.

types.name: PoseSampling
types.doc: Shared authored grid density for selection and retained execution.

fields.name: pieces
fields.doc:
Pieces at most `resolution` long, a quarter radian of curvature apart and `angularResolution` radians of turning
apart. `exactAffine` says the joints are an exact affine function of the pose (`AffineJointMap`): a straight piece
that does not turn the tool is then a straight line in joint space too, however long, and one piece is all it needs.

types.name: PoseSlice
types.doc: An exact interval of an authored primitive, preserving its parameterization.

types.name: PoseWaypoint
types.doc: Authored pose and maximum Cartesian and angular error, in metres and radians.

types.name: PoseWeave
types.doc: A single smooth span of a weave, measured in the base primitive's seam progress.

fields.name: new
fields.signature: (base:PosePrimitive, from:Float, to:Float, offset:Float, profile:WeaveProfile, frame:WeaveFrame, total:Float, taper:Float, phase:Float):Void

types.name: QuinticBlend
types.doc: Planar quintic Hermite blend, parameterized numerically by arc length.

fields.name: positionErrorBound
fields.doc: The arc-length table is piecewise affine, so each table cell is an exact quintic in distance.

types.name: WeaveDirection
types.doc: Lateral material-frame axis and its seam-distance derivatives, in the base frame.

types.name: WeaveFrame
types.doc: Material frame independent of the torch's orientation and roll.

types.name: WeavePath
types.doc: Add a lateral weave without changing authored length, feed or event distances.

fields.name: Zigzag
fields.doc: Three parts outward traverse to one part return traverse.

types.name: WeaveProfile
types.doc: A spatial weave; edge holds consume forward progress, leaving frequency unchanged.

fields.name: new
fields.doc: Amplitude in metres, frequency in cycles/metre, edge dwell in seconds at nominal seam speed.

fields.name: breaks
fields.doc: Interior cycle joins, in global seam coordinates.

fields.name: at
fields.doc: At a join choose the derivative arriving from the left or leaving to the right.

types.name: WeaveSample
types.doc: Offset and exact first/second derivatives with respect to seam progress.

types.name: BindingConstraint
types.doc: Constraint that sets a reference timing span's path-speed bound.

fields.name: jointIndex
fields.doc: -1 identifies an authored speed cap.

types.name: BoxClearanceSpace
types.doc:
A planner space that can also prove whole axis-aligned boxes of configurations clear, so
motion that leaves the straight edges (a curve through a waypoint) can be certified by
covering it with boxes.

fields.name: boxesClear
fields.doc:
Whether every configuration within each box is clear, conservatively (a box it cannot
prove clear counts as blocked). `centres` and `halfWidths` hold `count` boxes of
`dimension()` values each; a box spans centre ± half width in every coordinate.

types.name: CachedPlannerSpace
types.doc:
Bounded exact-query cache for one immutable scene and policy.
The owner must discard/clear it when geometry, roots, limits, rules, margins
or subdivision policy changes. Posing bodies during queries is permitted.

types.name: JointPathClearanceProof
types.doc: Immutable evidence for a particular curve and a bounded lowering error.

types.name: JointPathPolynomial
types.doc: The normalized quintic Hermite polynomial consumed by native path.cpp.

types.name: JointPathSamples
types.doc: Joint path q(s) and its first two path derivatives at monotonic samples.

types.name: MotionPlan
types.doc: A planned path, or why there is none, with what planning cost.

fields.name: waypoints
fields.doc: Waypoints, start and goal included; null when planning failed.

fields.name: failure
fields.doc: Why planning failed ("" when it did not): the start or goal in collision, named, or no path found.

fields.name: edgeChecks
fields.doc: Edges checked, and the time spent in the space's checks and in planning overall.

fields.name: new
fields.signature: (?waypoints:Array<Array<Float>>, failure:String, iterations:Int, nodes:Int, edgeChecks:Int, checkSeconds:Float, totalSeconds:Float):Void

fields.name: length
fields.doc: The path's length in joint space (Euclidean over the waypoints).

types.name: MotionPlanner
types.doc:
Plans a collision-free path in joint space between two configurations
(COLLISION.md CL-D7, CL7). The path is a list of waypoints, start and goal
included, whose straight edges have been checked; a timed path must follow
them (rest to rest with phase synchronization).

types.name: PathPlanningOptions
types.doc: Corner policy for geometric-path planning.

fields.name: time
fields.doc: Times q(s), lowers it, and retains the same distance-to-time law.

types.name: PathTimingLimits
types.doc: Joint limits, optional per-span feed caps, and endpoint path speeds.

fields.name: speedCaps
fields.doc: Empty means no authored feed caps; zero in one span means uncapped.

types.name: PathTimingPreview
types.doc:
Owned candidate. Peek for certification, then commit to transfer its result.
Discarding an uncommitted candidate disposes both its motion and distance map.

fields.name: peek
fields.doc: Borrowed until commitTiming transfers it, or dispose releases it.

fields.name: commitTiming
fields.doc: Retire stable raw timing into unpublished transform context. This never certifies execution.

types.name: PathTimingStream
types.doc:
One planning worker's bounded native timing queue. Returned candidates own
their results independently of the source path and this stream's lifetime.

fields.name: selectJoints
fields.doc: Select physical output joints while retaining all timing constraints, before the first step.

types.name: PlannerQueryKey
types.doc: Exact IEEE-754 keys: nearby configurations must never share collision answers.

types.name: PlannerRandom
types.doc: A seeded generator (xorshift32), so plans repeat exactly.

fields.name: next
fields.doc: Uniform in [0, 1).

types.name: PlannerSpace
types.doc:
The configuration space a `MotionPlanner` searches: joint bounds, which
configurations are valid, and which straight edges are clear. Edge checks
come in batches, so a space backed by native collision checks makes one
call for many edges (COLLISION.md CL-D7).

fields.name: invalid
fields.doc: Why `q` is not valid (what collides, named), or null when it is.

fields.name: edgesClear
fields.doc:
Whether each straight edge is clear, conservatively (an edge it cannot
prove clear counts as blocked). `edges` holds `count` edges, each its
start then its end (`dimension()` values each). Ends are known valid.

types.name: PlannerTree
types.doc:
A search tree with its nodes stored flat (one array of coordinates, one of
parents) and nearest-neighbour queries by a k-d tree over the nodes it was
last built from, plus a scan of those added since (COLLISION.md CL-D7). The
k-d tree is rebuilt whenever the tree doubles past `kdThreshold` nodes.

fields.name: pathTo
fields.doc: The path from the root to `index`, root first.

types.name: RrtConnect
types.doc:
Bidirectional RRT-Connect in joint space, then shortcutting (COLLISION.md
CL-D7, CL7), over a `PlannerSpace`. Deterministic from its seed: the same
seed, space and endpoints give the same path.

Each iteration samples a configuration, extends one tree toward it by at
most `step` (Euclidean, joint units), and tries to connect the other tree
to the new node: its nearest node's straight steps toward it are checked in
bounded batches, stopping at the first blocked edge and adding only the
clear prefix; reaching the node joins the
trees. Trees store nodes flat and find neighbours by k-d tree once they
grow (`PlannerTree`). Shortcutting then tries `shortcutRounds` random
direct edges between waypoints, in batches. A final visibility pass keeps
the farthest certified successor of each retained waypoint, so random
shortcutting leaves fewer avoidable stops in a rest-to-rest motion, within
a separate bounded collision-check budget.

fields.name: visibilityCheckLimit
fields.doc: Maximum edge checks in the final visibility pass; zero disables it.

types.name: SavedPathValidation
types.doc: A saved route is only a proposal: endpoints, bounds, points and whole edges are rechecked.

types.name: SimplePathTiming
types.doc: Deterministic reference timer using conservative trapezoids in path distance.

types.name: TimedPath
types.doc: Lowered trajectory plus its exact path-distance timing contract.

fields.name: bindingConstraints
fields.doc: Which limit bound each stage of the time law; read lazily, and only while the time law is still held.

fields.name: new
fields.doc:
`timesToDistancesMap`, when the timing backend can invert its time law directly, maps many times to
path distances in one step; callers otherwise search with `distanceToTime`.

fields.name: takeSelectedJoints
fields.doc:
Consume this result, transferring its distance-law ownership to a selected-joint copy.
Failure leaves the original result live. The selected copy preserves lazy binding diagnostics.

fields.name: timesToDistances
fields.doc: Path distance reached at each time; only valid when `hasDirectInverse()`.

fields.name: releaseDistanceMap
fields.doc: Releases the native time law after all path events have been lowered.

types.name: TimedPathSeries
types.doc:
One owner's retained clock laws. Streaming keeps only filter/event context;
a whole-path request drains the same laws and joins their polynomial output.

fields.name: append
fields.doc: Takes ownership; the caller may borrow the result until it retires.

fields.name: timesToDistances
fields.doc: One bulk inverse call per retained law, preserving arbitrary caller order.

fields.name: finish
fields.doc: Transfers the joined output; its distance-law lifetime becomes the result's.

types.name: ToppraPathTiming
types.doc: Reachability timing using the native TOPP-RA Seidel LP backend.

fields.name: windowedPaths
fields.doc:
Paths timed in more than one window, and how many times their windows' boundary speeds had to be lowered before
they could be timed (each lowering costs speed; three are a rest at every boundary). Diagnostics of this instance's
plans, for a caller that times on one thread.

fields.name: time
fields.doc: Whole-path timing is the same stream drained to completion, retaining its exact distance laws.

types.name: Blend
types.doc: Junction policy requested between consecutive motion operations.

fields.name: FlyBy
fields.doc:
Pass a planned joint target without stopping where the curved motion through it can be
certified clear; otherwise stop there. Joins consecutive planned `MoveJ` operations.

types.name: InputPredicate
types.doc: Serializable condition used by a WaitInput barrier.

types.name: MotionOp
types.doc: Controller-independent requested motion and program barriers.

fields.name: WaitInput
fields.doc: A null timeout waits indefinitely.

types.name: MotionPath
types.doc: Authored path data accepted by FollowPath implementations.

types.name: MotionProgram
types.doc: Ordered motion request with structural validation and a copied operation list.

fields.name: configuration
fields.doc: Hard geometric configuration and optional physical turns for the complete program.

fields.name: validate
fields.doc: Returns the first structural error, including the operation index.

types.name: MoveTarget
types.doc: Joint-space or framed Cartesian endpoint for a MoveJ operation.

fields.name: JointPosition
fields.doc: Absolute position of one independent joint; all others retain their planned coordinates.

fields.name: JointOffset
fields.doc:
One joint moved by `delta` from wherever the program has it, the joints that follow it (a motor behind a gear
pair) moving with it. `MotionOptions` limits are the driven joint's; the followers' are in proportion.

types.name: AnalyticBranch
types.doc: A geometric branch and its legal periodic lift; singularities stay explicit.

fields.name: singularityKnown
fields.doc: Numeric fallback cannot classify geometric singularities.

types.name: AnalyticIk
types.doc: Geometric branch enumeration, independent of timing and process runners.

types.name: AnalyticPathRefiner
types.doc:
Analytic refinement on one geometric branch. Branch-transition
segmentation is handled separately.

fields.name: constrain
fields.doc:
Fit one global banded QP so stopped sections share identical positions.
The exact branch is re-solved and its linear bounds updated at most three times.

fields.name: derivatives
fields.doc:
Task rates must describe the refined TCP pose, including its smoothed
orientation. External redundancy rates come directly from the spline.

fields.name: refinedDerivatives
fields.doc:
The supplied six-dimensional rates describe OrientationLattice.centre,
including any changing cone axis. Spline swing/roll rates are added here.

fields.name: refinePath
fields.doc:
Produce the complete refined path for timing, preserving curvature on
both sides of a geometric knot. The provider supplies exact task data.

fields.name: refineSection
fields.doc:
Refine a timing section of the globally selected route. Distances and
task coordinates remain global, so redundancy splines are shared across
stops. The section task supplies its own one-sided endpoint derivatives.

types.name: ArrayStreamSegments
types.doc: Segments held as Haxe values, such as a trajectory's.

types.name: AxisJointPathPlanner
types.doc: Exact affine logical-axis mapping, including motor scales and coupled followers.

types.name: AxisKinematics
types.doc: Exact Cartesian kinematics for an XYZ machine's logical axis mapping.

fields.name: affineMap
fields.doc:
The joints are exactly affine in the logical axes: each axis scales and offsets its joints and the followers sum
their terms. Read off by placing the tool at the origin and a metre along each axis, limits aside (a joint no axis
owns and nothing drives, an extruder, stays zero).

fields.name: solvePath
fields.doc: Logical axes have one solution per pose: the path follows point by point.

fields.name: fork
fields.doc: Nothing here changes once built.

fields.name: derivedProjection
fields.doc: Shared read-only projection used when a process coordinate is written after IK.

types.name: AxisPlanner
types.doc: Joint-axis planner with immutable machine configuration and no request state.

fields.name: new
fields.doc: `derived` are the joints that follow several axes (see `MotionAxisCouplings.derived`); the planner projects them.

types.name: BlockedLadderEdge
types.doc: Candidate indices are local to adjacent source layers.

types.name: BranchIk
types.doc: Selects an FK-verified model-derived family; unsupported geometry stays explicit.

types.name: CandidateProblem
types.doc: Candidate ladder construction; discrete selection and timing are separate.

fields.name: configuration
fields.doc: Hard branch/lift constraint, also applied to refinement re-solves.

fields.name: pruneUnreachableBounds
fields.doc:
Conservative forward reachability bounds. A state outside any joint's
predecessor envelope cannot belong to a legal complete route.

types.name: CartesianAdmittance
types.doc:
Explicit six-axis virtual mass/damper admittance. `target` and the wrench
passed to `step` are the environment-on-tool wrench at the TCP, expressed in
the same caller-selected control axes. `step` returns a TCP velocity
correction in those axes; callers own sensor transforms, freshness, travel
limits and ServoSession deadlines.

step
fields.doc: Integrate M*a + D*v = measured - target, with a commissioned stable sample bound.

fields.name: dampingOf
fields.doc: The commissioned damping of one axis: a steady force error `f` moves that axis at `f / damping`.

types.name: CartesianAnalyticIk
types.doc: Model-derived XYZ and C/A heads, evaluated in the group's fixed reference.

fields.name: nativeModel
fields.doc: Immutable descriptor for native lattice sampling.

types.name: CartesianCandidateSampler
types.doc: One native Cartesian orientation/branch/lift call, with model-derived limits.

types.name: ClearanceEvent
types.doc: A change to the cell at a time of one compiled motion (seconds from its start; COLLISION.md CL-D9).

fields.name: op
fields.doc: The program op whose motion it happens in.

types.name: CoarseSearchOptions
types.doc: Approximate corridor optimization; disconnected corridors widen or revert to full search.

types.name: CollisionPlannerSpace
types.doc:
A `PlannerSpace` over a collisionkit world (COLLISION.md CL-D5, CL-D7):
a model's bodies in a built description, checked against the world with
`margins` (the safety margins plus the planner's slack).

An edge is clear when its midpoint is clear with each body inflated by its
`MotionReach` bound over half the edge's per-joint travel: then no point
of any body comes closer along the whole edge. Otherwise it is halved, to
`depthLimit`; an edge whose midpoint collides as it is, or that is still
open at the limit, is blocked. Each bounded batch of pending intervals
uses one native call for the inflated checks and one for flagged
midpoints as they are.

The same inflated check proves a whole box of configurations clear: every
configuration within the per-joint travel of the centre stays inside the
inflated bodies (`boxesClear`).

fields.name: queries
fields.doc: Halvings run for the edges checked so far (diagnostics).

fields.name: violation
fields.doc: Structured diagnostics for callers that need the actual contact pair.

types.name: CompiledProgram
types.doc: Validated plan blocks and nonfatal planning notes. Owns its plans.

fields.name: takeBlocks
fields.doc: Transfer plan ownership once to the execution queue.

types.name: ConfigurationConstraint
types.doc: Verify a physical state using labelled IK, including external-group adapters.

fields.name: checkTrajectory
fields.doc:
Check the generated execution states at controller ticks and segment boundaries.
This is a sampled geometric check, not a continuous branch certificate.

types.name: CouplingProjection
types.doc:
The couplings of a machine as one projection: a follower joint is the sum of its terms, `ratio * leader + offset`, taken
from joints that are complete before it. Built once from the model's terms: the followers come in dependency order (each
after the joints it follows), their terms grouped, and a cycle is an error (a joint cannot follow itself). Everything
that sets followers from their leaders (positions, rates, a trajectory's coefficients, the limits a follower inherits)
walks this one order.

fields.name: followers
fields.doc: The coupled joints, each after the coupled joints among its leaders.

fields.name: termFollowers
fields.doc: The terms, grouped by follower in `followers` order.

fields.name: of
fields.doc:
The projection of `terms` (joint indices below `jointCount`). Followers are ordered by dependency, and the terms of a
follower keep their authored order (the sum is taken in that order). Throws on a cycle.

fields.name: termsOf
fields.doc: The terms of `follower` as (leader, ratio, offset), in the order they are summed.

fields.name: complete
fields.doc: Sets every coupled joint of `q` to the sum of its terms: positions take the offsets, rates (`positions` false) do not.

fields.name: addLimits
fields.doc: Sets every coupled joint of `limits` to what its terms add up to when each leader is at its limit: the sum of |ratio| * leader.

fields.name: trajectory
fields.doc: A copy of `source` in which every follower is again exactly the sum of its terms (after a lowering that treated joints independently).

types.name: CubicRedundancyCurve
types.doc: C2 Hermite cubic supplied by the native constrained optimizer.

types.name: DistanceDriveColumns
types.doc: The process coordinate and its followers, applied after any geometric IK/refinement.

fields.name: affects
fields.doc: These authored process changes are not inverse-kinematic branch jumps.

fields.name: holdPosition

fields.name: applyOwned

Native banded QP over redundancy values and path derivatives. The arm
supplies local linear bounds, then exact IK checks the resulting geometry.

types.name: EaikKinematics

types.name: ExternalAxesParameterization
types.doc:
A cell's redundancy: the values of its external axes (a rail, a
positioner). The arm solves for the tool at given external values; the
search makes the external axes cheaper to move than the arm, so they bring
the work to a comfortable arm.

fields.name: externalCost
fields.doc: Cost factor of an external axis's motion against the arm's.

fields.name: new
fields.doc: `angularRate` (rad per metre of path) and `linearRate` (m per metre) set the lattice resolution.

types.name: ExternalAxisGrid

fields.name: normalizeSeed
fields.doc: Canonical external seeds with sub-nanometre/sub-nanoradian stop residuals.

types.name: GearCheckState
types.doc:
Planning mirror of the runtime event protocol. Process speed channels provide master velocity.
A process spindle's acceleration envelope must be declared explicitly for torque checks.

fields.name: processVelocity
fields.doc: Null for an ordinary trajectory master; process speed is in joint SI units.

types.name: HandlingPlanRunner
types.doc:
Picks and places with an arm: a motion program that comes to the contact point along an approach
at `approachHeight`, sets the tool's hold channel there, dwells while it seals or lets go, then
rises again. A free-orientation tool returns home; a tool with a requested orientation remains at
the raised pose so a following operation can carry the held part without folding through the
home posture. Motion runs through `ManipulatorMotion` like every other arm program. To pick, it
presses `pressDepth` past the contact, as a compliant suction cup is pressed onto a part,
so the cup meets the part within the motion's position tolerance.
Without an explicit orientation the tool keeps its home Z direction and spin is free.
A requested orientation fixes its heading as well. Other joints, such as a mobile base's
wheels, hold still while the program runs.

fields.name: DEFAULT_APPROACH_HEIGHT
fields.doc: Default vertical clearance between the grasp plane and the transport pose.

fields.name: home
fields.doc: The arm's home joints, in its chain order, and the tool's pose there in the base frame.

fields.name: openBeforePick
fields.doc: Open a physical gripper and allow its valve/stroke dwell before approaching a new part.

fields.name: gripperTolerance
fields.doc: Physical pad placement needs the same geometric precision in study and execution.

fields.name: home

Where the axis rests after homing: the authored home, the same coordinate every other part of the motion system
knows as the axis's home (`MotionAxis.homePosition`). A drive that comes to rest a step past a home on a travel limit
is admitted by the plan validator's start rule, not by moving the home.

fields.name: stoppingDistance

fields.name: calibrationReady

Continuous quintic-path certificate, with hull displacement reserved for
native lowering. Bernstein subdivision bounds every configuration between
samples; it never treats a sampled chord sweep as a continuous proof.

fields.doc:
Phase-gate audit: compare actual lowered motion with the authored quintic
at distances from the native time law, and measure hull displacement.

types.name: JointCurveTask
types.doc:
Continuous task bounds for the actual quintic, including native lowering.
The linearized FK residual is a Bernstein polynomial. Rigid-chain Taylor
remainders, authored arc curvature and lowering displacement bound the rest.
Unsupported primitives or an inconclusive bound retain dense checking.

types.name: JointKinematics
types.doc: Joint-program planning for machines without a Cartesian tool frame.

types.name: JointLifts
types.doc: Native finite-limit filtering and complete periodic lifts of a geometric branch.

types.name: JointMotionPolicy
types.doc:
Requested joint planning rates, in radians or metres per second powers.
These are software planning settings, not hardware ratings. Mechanical
velocity and acceleration ceilings still constrain every joint.

fields.name: mission
fields.doc: The standard robot mission planning profile.

types.name: JointPathPlanner
types.doc: Select/refine geometry. The caller owns the returned curve and may apply process columns before timing.

fields.name: proveMotion
fields.doc:
The conservative clearance check of a timed motion (`TrajectoryClearanceProof`), or null
without a clearance world. `velocity` bounds each joint's speed over the motion.

fields.name: clearanceWorld
fields.doc: The clearance world the planner checks with, or null.

types.name: JointPathPreferences
types.doc: Immutable request preferences; FK always uses the planning worker's group.

fields.name: forProblem
fields.doc:
Exact analytic branches and physical turns share one task orientation
per lattice cell (their native FK witnesses are within 1e-9). Posture and
caller costs still use every physical joint vector independently.

types.name: JointPathTiming
types.doc: Time certified straight joint edges with synchronized, jerk-limited stops.

fields.name: blended
fields.doc:
Time a certified joint path passing its interior waypoints without stopping where `space`
proves the curved motion clear. Each waypoint gets a pass velocity: per joint, the slower
of its two edges' average speeds when both edges move it the same way, else zero. A segment
whose motion `space` cannot cover with clear boxes halves the pass speeds at its ends, down
to the certified straight edge stopped at both ends, so the result is never less clear than
`trajectory(path)`; it is used only when it is also faster.

fields.name: labelArm
fields.doc:
Preserve native branch/joint evidence; materialize display labels and
turn arrays only when a pin, selected route or caller requests them.

types.doc:
Check only winning routes and disable colliding sample candidates.
Failed sweeps exclude transitions; final sweeps report sampled clearance.
